# Term inventory

Generated 2026-11-10 by owner-rules/term-inventory.mjs from the player-facing text of WIZARD and the ARPG and the WIZARD docs. Machine-readable copy: TERM-INVENTORY.json.

Rule: Keep a term only if (a) the owner introduced it, (b) it is a plain English description of what it does, or (c) it is the standard PoE1/PoE2 term used in the same meaning. Everything else is purged (renamed plainly, or removed with its mechanic if that mechanic was invented and does nothing). 'Spirit' and 'blood' were named by the owner as made up (2026-11-08).

Origin: owner (the owner introduced it; evidence quoted), poe (standard PoE term, same meaning), plain (plain English, used plainly), real-world (real place, person, object), technical (code or tool jargon), other-game, agent-invented. Kinds: label (word of a Title Case name), game (player-facing text or data), doc (WIZARD docs).
